# Preferences

Every setting, by the page of the preferences window it sits on. Start with [General](#general).

## General

### Window

#### Use native Wayland (Linux only)

`window.nativeWayland`

Run directly on Wayland instead of XWayland. Some window features differ. Applies after a restart.

Default: off. See [Linux](linux.md#display).

## Confirmations

### Window

#### Confirm before closing

`confirm.close`

Ask before closing a window with running terminals. See [Wayland](#window.nativeWayland).
